test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

MN _ _ SM _ PO _ _ N _ OSM _ P _ S
solution:
• PONSMPNO → MN **PO** S / M **N** PO **S / M** N **P** OS / M **N** P **O** S
 
• PNOSMPNO → MN **PN** S / M **O** PO **S / M** N **P** OS / M **N** P **O** S
 
• PONMSPNO → MN **PO** S / M **N** PO **M / S** N **P** OS / M **N** P **O** S
 
• PONSNOMP → MN **PO** S / M **N** PO **S / N** N **O** OS / M **M** P B S

 
• In option 1, MNPOS is repeated.

Hence, ‘**PONSMPNO**’ is the correct answer.
